video_title: Jamison Battle | Post Game vs Los Angeles Lakers | November 01, 2026

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamison Battle on his role and expectations within the organization
quotes.excerpt: go out there, play free, just do what you're expected to do and just go out there
quotes.quote: I think that's just the expectation anyway. So go out there, play free, just do what you're expected to do and just go out there and play for your teammates. I think everyone in this organization has belief in me, but more importantly, I just want to contribute to winning and help the team. I feel like with that, that's what I do. So when times like that happen, you have to translate it and be able to do what you just did at the end of the game for a full 48.
quotes.social_post: Jamison Battle says the expectation is to play free and contribute to winning. He emphasizes the need to translate late game success into a full 48 minute effort.

structured.context: Jamison Battle discusses his mindset and expectations after a game against the Los Angeles Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamison Battle on maintaining an aggressive team mentality
quotes.excerpt: no matter who's in the game, you put your best foot forward and trying to play to our identity
quotes.quote: Just go out there and play hard, and I think that's our motto as an organization as a unit. No matter who's in the game, you put your best foot forward and trying to play to our identity. I think that's what we did. Obviously, having them put the starters back in, I think that shows how hard we were playing. For them to do that is a testament to the hard work that we were putting in, but obviously we want to go out there and just try to win the game. So that was our mentality going in and just to make an impact like that is important and carrying it on to tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Jamison Battle says the Lakers putting their starters back in against the Raptors bench is a testament to how hard the team was playing. He says the goal remains to play to the team identity and win.

structured.context: Jamison Battle reflects on the team's hard-playing identity and the Lakers decision to re-insert their starters during the game.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamison Battle on maintaining a neutral head space during games
quotes.excerpt: trying to stay present in the moment is the biggest thing throughout that, but staying neutral
quotes.quote: I think it's just trying to be in a neutral head space. Trying to stay present in the moment is the biggest thing throughout that, but staying neutral, whether you're going backwards or you're going forwards, you're trying to stay even keel and not letting the past affect you, not letting what's in the future affect you. Just trying to stay present in the moment, only controlling what you can control and just staying in that moment.
quotes.social_post: Jamison Battle on his mental approach during games. He says the key is staying in a neutral head space and not letting the past or future affect his performance.

structured.context: Jamison Battle explains his approach to maintaining a neutral and present mindset during game action.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamison Battle on mental toughness and focus during games
quotes.excerpt: if you're mentally strong and have that fortitude, I think it's something that you can overcome
quotes.quote: Just because there's so many extracurriculars going on, but I think if you're mentally strong and have that fortitude, I think it's something that you can overcome. There's always going to be different things going on, but it's just how can you recenter and how can you find that neutrality through it.
quotes.social_post: Jamison Battle discusses the importance of mental fortitude in the NBA. He says the challenge is finding neutrality and recentering when there are so many extracurriculars going on.

structured.context: Jamison Battle discusses the importance of mental fortitude and recentering oneself amidst game distractions.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamison Battle on his offensive approach and reading the game
quotes.excerpt: the biggest thing for me is not trying to shy away from being run off the line
quotes.quote: The biggest thing for me is not trying to shy away from being run off the line, but taking those threes if their hands are down too, but just playing two dribbles if that, just to get off the ball or to get in the paint and create for others. I think it's just reading the game, not necessarily predetermining what's going on, but if they're running at me and forcing me not to shoot, I mean, obviously you read it from there, but my mentality is to just shoot first regardless.
quotes.social_post: Jamison Battle explains his offensive mentality. He says he is looking to shoot first but is focused on reading the game and making the right play if he is run off the line.

structured.context: Jamison Battle describes his offensive decision-making process and his shoot-first mentality.
